primary_endpoint.contact_definition: trace.axial_support AND trace.normal_force > 0.3 N on a valid control step
primary_endpoint.traversal_interval: inclusive interval from first qualifying contact to first mode-specific outlet crossing

threshold_rationale.maximum_loss: Half of the inherited 0.3 s physical contact-loss window; at 20 ms control this permits at most seven consecutive missing-contact ticks.
threshold_rationale.coverage: A chatter-tolerant majority-contact requirement. The independent maximum-gap condition prevents a free-space traverse from satisfying the ratio.
threshold_rationale.qualification: Thresholds are fixed from task timing and successful Panda source trajectories before final target evaluation.

historical_results: Earlier lift-off-permitting results remain development evidence under task_contract_v1 and are not relabeled as strict-contact successes.
